Hey there stranger. I’m Alex, on a mission to empower people. And you, what is your Personal myth?
Since you’re here, here are 4 more things about me, see if this site is worth digging into:

  • I studied cybersecurity, computer science and did my master thesis in a month with AI. Here’s the most useful way to get started there, free guide for you: prompting guide.pdf
  • I’m all into beauty emerging from chaos. Been to Asia a few times. Travel
  • I’m addicted to learning, and there is still a bunch of stuff I haven’t put out here, or refined. The only updated version of this site is me! why you should write
  • I’d rather talk via signal. Whatsapp tracks metadata, and for instagram: why I deleted my social media accounts.

Little bit lost? No worries, that’s why there is a Vault Map and help button. Most of the important stuff is in the root, but take your time, this isn’t meant to be consumed quickly.
There’s everything, even a life management system here, overview.excalidraw.
Come back when curiosity takes you.
I’m assuming that if you found this site, you can find me.
